device.name: AgileX Scout V2 Gazebo empty world

facts.text: scout_empty_world.launch defaults robot_namespace to /.
scout_empty_world.launch defaults world_name to $(find scout_gazebo_sim)worlds/weston_robot_empty.world.
scout_empty_world.launch includes $(find gazebo_ros)/launch/empty_world.launch.
That include passes paused false, use_sim_time true, gui true, headless false and debug false.
scout_empty_world.launch includes spawn_scout_v2.launch.
spawn_scout_v2.launch defines arg paused with default true.
spawn_model is invoked with -unpause and -model 'scout$(arg robot_namespace)'.
spawn_scout_v2.launch loads scout_v2_control.yaml onto the parameter server.
controller_spawner is started with scout_state_controller and the four scout_motor_fr, fl, rl and rr controllers.
The scout_skid_steer_controller node sets the private robot_namespace parameter from the launch arg.
scout_v2.gazebo loads the plugin gazebo_ros_control from libgazebo_ros_control.so.
The skid_steer_drive_controller block that names libgazebo_ros_skid_steer_drive.so is inside an XML comment.
The object_controller block that names libgazebo_ros_planar_move.so is inside an XML comment.
ScoutSkidSteer sets cmd_topic_ to robot_name_ concatenated with the literal /cmd_vel.

ScoutSkidSteer sets the four motor command topics to robot_name_ concatenated with /scout_motor_fr_controller/command, /scout_motor_fl_controller/command, /scout_motor_rl_controller/command and /scout_motor_rr_controller/command.
SetupSubscription subscribes to cmd_topic_ as geometry_msgs::Twist with queue size 5.
SetupSubscription advertises four std_msgs::Float64 publishers on the motor command topics.
scout_skid_steer.cpp includes geometry_msgs/Twist.h and std_msgs/Float64.h.
TwistCmdCallback reads linear.x and angular.z, sets k to 1.4, and publishes four Float64 commands.
The header sets SCOUT_WHEELBASE to 0.498 and SCOUT_WHEEL_RADIUS to 0.16459.
The header includes geometry_msgs/Twist.h.
The header declares TwistCmdCallback.
scout_skid_steer_controller initialises the node name scout_odom and reads the private parameter robot_namespace with default string scout_default.
The node then calls SetupSubscription and ros::spin.
scout_v2_control.yaml sets scout_state_controller to joint_state_controller/JointStateController with publish_rate 50 and names no topic.
scout_v2_control.yaml sets four controllers to velocity_controllers/JointVelocityController.
scout_gazebo_sim package.xml declares the license BSD.
scout_gazebo_sim package.xml buildtool_depend is catkin.
scout_gazebo_sim package.xml run_depend entries include gazebo_ros and gazebo_ros_control.
The Scout README names ROS Melodic on the development-environment line.
The Scout README installs ros-melodic-ros-controllers with apt-get.
The Scout README installs ros-melodic-gazebo-ros with apt-get.
The Scout README installs ros-melodic-gazebo-ros-control with apt-get.
The gazebo_ros gzserver wrapper adds libgazebo_ros_api_plugin to the server's plugins unless the arguments already name it.
empty_world.launch starts the Gazebo server as the node named gazebo of package gazebo_ros, with the physics engine argument -e $(arg physics).
empty_world.launch defaults its physics argument to ode.
empty_world.launch defaults its gui argument to true.
When gui is true, empty_world.launch starts the node gazebo_gui of type gzclient.
The API plugin calls ros::init with the node name gazebo when ROS is not initialised yet.
The API plugin creates its node handle in the private namespace ~ and advertises its topics and services there.
The API plugin advertises the service pause_physics with the std_srvs::Empty type on its own callback queue gazebo_queue_.
The API plugin advertises the service get_physics_properties with the gazebo_msgs::GetPhysicsProperties type on gazebo_queue_.
gazeboQueueThread serves gazebo_queue_ in a loop with a 0.001 s wall-clock wait while the node handle is ok.
pausePhysics calls world_->SetPaused(true) and returns true.
unpausePhysics calls world_->SetPaused(false) and returns true.
getPhysicsProperties sets res.pause to world_->IsPaused().
getPhysicsProperties sets success true only when the physics engine type is ode; for any other engine it sets success false and returns false.
The GetPhysicsProperties response field pause is true if the physics engine is paused.
Among the world-update begin hooks that its comment says apply forces and publish sim time on /clock, the API plugin connects publishSimTime.
The API plugin advertises the relative name model_states as gazebo_msgs::ModelStates on gazebo_queue_.
onModelStatesConnect connects publishModelStates to WorldUpdateBegin when the subscriber count becomes 1.
publishModelStates appends each model's GetName, a pose taken from WorldPose and a twist taken from WorldLinearVel and WorldAngularVel, then publishes the ModelStates message.
ModelStates.msg declares name, pose and twist arrays, and its comments call pose and twist desired.
gazebo_ros_control connects its Update to the world-update begin event.
gazebo_ros_control's Update reads the simulation time, updates the controllers and writes their commands to the simulated joints.
World::Step advances simulation time and calls Update only when the world is not paused, a step increment is pending or a reset is due; otherwise it adds the step to the pause time.
World::Step holds worldUpdateMutex while it steps the world.
World::SetPaused stores the paused flag under worldUpdateMutex.
World::IsPaused returns the stored paused flag.
World::Update fires the worldUpdateBegin event and then updates every model.
World::Step calls ProcessMessages after the paused or unpaused branch, so pending messages are processed on every step, paused or not.
A WorldControl message with step calls OnStep, and one with multi_step pauses the world and sets the number of steps to run while paused.

determinism.notes: Event-driven fake with no physics step, pacing or controller dynamics; it is not a replay of captured ROS traffic

fidelity.engine: analytic:ROS-free rosbridge fake (no Gazebo or physics)
gaps: the fake answers /cmd_vel and the two companion Gazebo services; it runs no Gazebo, ros_control controller or Scout dynamics
a /cmd_vel publication is recorded as the transmitted Twist; the fake does not apply wheel velocities and does not claim that a JointVelocityController replaced a held setpoint

TwistCmdCallback publishes four Float64 values from linear.x and angular.z with k = 1.4 (scout_skid_steer.cpp:37-57) and stores no Twist; a zero Twist therefore publishes four zeros, which is not evidence about the external velocity controllers

no unpause is offered: spawn_scout_v2.launch passes -unpause to spawn_model (spawn_scout_v2.launch:25), and unpausePhysics exists in the companion (gazebo_ros_api_plugin.cpp:1668-1672); this package calls neither, because the controller source is not in the clone
the stop is the companion gazebo_ros world pause; the fake keeps a paused flag that /gazebo/pause_physics sets and /gazebo/get_physics_properties reports; it runs no Gazebo World::Step

publishModelStates runs from WorldUpdateBegin, which World::Update fires; Update still runs while paused when stepInc > 0 or needsReset is true (World.cc:691-697), and SetPaused does not clear stepInc (World.cc:1428-1436); /gazebo/model_states is not a command of this package (the clone never names it, and a command binding may not cite the companion)
the device resource reads no topic, so a command and a reset do not wait on a silent publisher; the cmd_vel receipt reports the values it sent

World::Step still calls ProcessMessages while paused, and a WorldControl multi_step runs steps while paused (World.cc:691-718 and 1462-1477); the Gazebo GUI that empty_world.launch opens by default, or any other client, can unpause or step the world; MHS does not watch the flag after the e-stop

scout_skid_steer_controller runs ros::spin in its own process (scout_skid_steer_controller.cpp:27), so it can receive a Twist while Gazebo is paused; whether the external controllers apply the resulting Float64 publications is not in this clone
the read-back needs the ODE engine (empty_world.launch's default physics): with another engine get_physics_properties returns false and the e-stop stays unconfirmed with the latch held
the deployment's gazebo_ros and Gazebo must be the pinned 2.8.7 (Melodic) and 9.19.0 releases the companion citations name; rosbridge cannot read their versions

scout_empty_world.launch writes world_name as $(find scout_gazebo_sim)worlds/weston_robot_empty.world, with no slash between the package find and worlds/ (scout_empty_world.launch:6); this package does not launch Gazebo and does not patch that line
the served launch is scout_empty_world.launch only; the other product directories of this repository are outside this package
the joint_state_controller publish_rate is 50 and the yaml names no joint_states topic, so this package does not bind /joint_states

safe_state.description: Read-back of get_physics_properties observed pause true, only the World pause flag at that call and not a measured standstill: a pending stepInc, needsReset, a manual step, a reset or a callback can still run World::Update (World.cc:691-697), SetPaused does not clear pending steps (World.cc:1428-1436), another client can resume the world, and MHS does not monitor the flag afterwards.
